description: Permanently empties the XDG Trash (~/.local/share/Trash). Deleted files cannot be recovered. Supports “Only delete items older than N days” (0 = everything).

fields.name: MinAgeDays
fields.label: Only delete items older than
fields.helpText: Only trash items trashed more than this many days ago will be permanently deleted (0 = everything).
fields.helpDetail: Based on the trash timestamp (DeletionDate in info/*.trashinfo), not the file's own modification time. Items with a missing timestamp are deleted when this is 0, conservatively kept otherwise. All deletions remove the files/ + info/ pair directly and verify it is gone (gio trash --empty is a silent no-op on this stack, so it is deliberately not used).
